name: plan-record-mutations
body: The plan-record arms: `apg plan add <project>` (was `init`) refuses when the plan file exists; `apg plan update <project> [--title] [--strategy]` mutates title/strategy (fixing the stale-strategy gap); `apg plan rm <project>` removes the whole transient plan, requiring `--force` when it has phases. Built on the existing `plan_init_at` refusal pattern and the `write_through` JSONL funnel.
